name: 77-ruby-position-align
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 28px; } p { margin: 20px 0; } ruby { ruby-position: over; ruby-align: center; } rt { font-size: 50%; } .under ruby { ruby-position: under; } .start ruby { ruby-align: start; } .around ruby { ruby-align: space-around; }
html:
居中注音：漢字汉排列

下方注音：山水山相逢

起始对齐：長風长万里

环绕对齐：明月明当空
